How AI and Machine Learning are Advancing Academic Research: 
Universities and research institutes around the world are key drivers of discovery and innovation, and 
professors and researchers are looking for answers to the biggest questions facing each academic 
discipline. With powerful GPU computing resources, academics can use AI, machine learning, and data 
science to more swiftly advance knowledge in fields such as astrophysics and astronomy, biology, earth 
and climate science, humanities, medicine, and physics.
